integrity: The proof is a mathematical computable reduction and finite-witness semidecision argument. Finite diagnostics are supplemental; no independence or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The decision problem has countably many propositional letters and an infinite formula-language closure given by an effective membership procedure, not an explicit finite table. The upper bound is relative to totality of that procedure; the hard family uses syntactically total primitive-recursive procedures. Same-carrier representation only; no finite-alphabet claim. Possible priority overlap with older effective syntactic-structure index-set theorems remains.
title: Recognition of finite effective closure models is \(\Pi^0_1\)-complete even under normality
